metadata.description: A curated collection of agent skills covering web video presentations, visual web design, local knowledge-base retrieval, GPT Image 2 image generation, beautifully designed single-file HTML articles, and code-rendered motion videos with narration and chapter builds. Also includes application QA and evidence review with agent-qa.

plugins.name: presentation-skills
plugins.description: Skills for click-driven web video presentations and screen-recorded explainers.

plugins.name: web-design-skills
plugins.description: Skills for high-quality visual / front-end design work.

plugins.name: knowledge-base-skills
plugins.description: Skills for local knowledge-base retrieval and document QA.

plugins.name: image-generation-skills
plugins.description: Skills for image generation and editing with GPT Image 2 (and OpenAI-compatible image endpoints), with three runtime modes and 70+ structured prompt templates.

plugins.name: motion-showreel-skills
plugins.description: Code-rendered motion videos up to 20 minutes: showreels, product films, UI motion, kinetic type, logo stings and narrated explainers. Independent music/SFX sources, Gemini/MiniMax TTS from user scripts, voice-led timing and cached chapter builds.

plugins.name: beautiful-article-skills
plugins.description: Skills for turning URL / PDF / DOCX / Markdown / text / screenshots into beautifully designed, offline-friendly single-file HTML articles via the reacticle component protocol.

plugins.name: agent-qa-skills
plugins.description: Selected application regression tests, recorded evidence review, and memidex knowledge inspection with agent-qa. Requires a configured local agent-qa project.
